data.narrative:
Figure AI, a Series C stage AI & Software company founded by Brett Adcock, is evaluated against a peer universe of 9 private companies and 1 public comparable (Palantir). The company has raised over $1.0B to date and carries a stated valuation of $39B, though that figure appears inconsistent with capital raised and is treated as unreliable in this analysis.

Stage-progression methodology was not applied after a sanity check revealed the $39B base would imply a $66.3B valuation following typical Series C step-ups—a multiple exceeding 20x total capital raised, signaling the source data is likely misclassified. Peer-median analysis, the primary applicable method, examined 7 same-sector and same/adjacent-stage comparables including Skild AI ($14.0B Series C), Scale AI ($29.0B Series B), Crusoe Energy ($10.0B Series C), and Wayve ($8.6B Series D). The median across this set is $8.6B, with a range spanning $2.0B to $29.0B.

The triangulation analysis supports a valuation range of $7.3B to $9.9B, centered on $8.6B. Key uncertainties include the reliability of recent fintech/AI software valuations given market volatility, the heterogeneity of business models and revenue maturity within the peer set, and whether Figure AI's stage or burn profile justifies a premium or discount to the median. Additional revenue and capital efficiency data would strengthen conviction in this range.
